scripts.certs: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && mkdir -p certs && host=$(node -p "new URL(process.env.JR2_PROVIDER_URL).hostname") && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 3650 -subj "/CN=intro llama CA" -keyout certs/ca.key -out certs/ca.crt && openssl req -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -subj "/CN=$host" -keyout certs/llama.key -out certs/llama.csr && printf "subjectAltName=IP:%s\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n" "$host" > certs/ext.cnf && openssl x509 -req -in certs/llama.csr -CA certs/ca.crt -CAkey certs/ca.key -CAcreateserial -days 365 -extfile certs/ext.cnf -out certs/llama.crt
scripts.llama: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && LLAMA_API_KEY="$JR2_PROVIDER_API_KEY" llama-server -hf unsloth/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF:UD-Q6_K_XL --alias qwen3.6-35b-a3b --no-mmproj --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --ssl-key-file certs/llama.key --ssl-cert-file certs/llama.crt --jinja --temp 0.6 --presence-penalty 1.0 -c 65536 -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 -fa on
